description: Generate random personal names typical of a country/region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Output is synthetic: for fiction, placeholders and test data. Not for impersonation or identity verification. On the paid remote server this returns the price and the exact URL to pay via x402 (USDC); pay= sets a pay-what-you-want amount above the minimum.

pay.description: Optional USDC amount above the minimum (paid server only)

seed.description: Optional; same seed gives same names

name: generate_names
